## Où j'en suis
Dashboards v2 landed: #418 (drag/resize widgets, ResizeObserver sizing, per-user layout) is merged after Priya's iPad review. The two follow-ups she asked for — keyboard move/resize and a visible focus ring — are built on branch `tom/dashboard-keyboard` as PR #423 (`useGridKeyboard`, 11 new tests green, commit `8f1a2c7`), open and waiting on Priya. `dashboards_v2` is on for zest-grocers on staging only; production is untouched. (source: ses-db-4, ses-db-3, src-pr418)

- [en-cours] PR #423 open: keyboard move/resize (Tab/Enter/arrows/Shift+Arrow/Escape, aria-live announcements) + 2px focus ring, Priya requested as reviewer (source: ses-db-4)
- [prochaine-étape] Priya rehearses the Zest demo on staging, then Tom flips the production flag himself the morning of the 24th (source: d4-06, d4-07)
- [essai-raté] dnd-kit's KeyboardSensor on top of react-grid-layout: both listen to the same pointer and key events, every move applied twice and mouse drags fired two layout changes; package removed (source: d4-02, d4-04)
- [décision] keep recharts and close the visx migration #401 for good — not worth two chart libs or rewriting 9 charts (source: c3-03, src-pr401)
- [décision] write our own keyboard handler on top of the layout state, no dnd-kit (source: d4-04)
- [décision] v1 dashboards stay available behind the flag until January, nothing removed now (source: b2-04)
